sources.agency: Mecklenburg County Tax Administration / Real Property
sources.notes: Official county real-property search by owner, parcel/PIN or situs address. Individual assessment/ownership records, not a countywide bulk file and not proof of delinquency. Use the normal gateway and any required disclaimer/session.

sources.agency: Mecklenburg County parcel data — NC DIT / CGIA (NC OneMap)
sources.notes: Complete Mecklenburg County parcel ownership/assessment layer within NC OneMap's statewide service; county-filtered Query gateway, not an individual lookup. Set Out Fields to *, Return Geometry to false for a table, format JSON, and paginate using Result Offset/Record Count (service limit 5000) or retrieve all object IDs and query batches. County counts and sample records were verified; one response is not a complete export. Includes parcel IDs, owner, mailing/situs address, land/improvement/parcel values, acreage, use codes and source dates where supplied. Source dates vary and some are invalid; this is not a certified current CAMA/tax roll. Request missing building detail/exemptions and current existing CAMA file from County Tax Administration. Older OneMap ZIP links returned 404 and were excluded.

sources.agency: Mecklenburg County Tax Administration / Collections
sources.notes: Use the annual real-estate delinquency publication, not the separate Top 100 ranking or personal-property/business lists. This dated annual publication omits later payments and may omit older tax years; verify balances in Tax Bill Lookup. The linked county open-mapping unpaid-bill export needs delinquency/date and real-property filtering.

sources.agency: Mecklenburg County Clerk of Superior Court — Special Proceedings
sources.notes: eCourts Portal Smart Search: choose Mecklenburg County/location and nonconfidential Special Proceedings for power-of-sale foreclosure cases (SP), then name/case number and filing date. Judicial foreclosures can also be Civil Actions; tax foreclosures are distinct and may be civil or in rem. This is a court case index, not a complete public-notice feed or Florida Lis Pendens. Filters need a search term. Older paper filings, missing documents and courthouse notices require the county Clerk; use the linked county Judicial Branch contact directory. All NC counties have eCourts as of October 13, 2025. Normal session/verification may be required; no bypass. Audit limitation: official Portal and Judicial Branch pages returned HTTP 403 in this environment, including a normal browser; no live case search/document retrieval was verified. The official statewide rollout and county Clerk routing were checked against Judicial Branch published pages; use normal user access or contact the county Clerk for records. No bypass automation.

Related nonconfidential estate Special Proceedings (SP) may be separate cases. Clerk of Superior Court administers estate files; Register of Deeds is not the probate custodian. All NC counties now use eCourts, but older paper documents and restricted/missing filings may need a Clerk request through the linked county contact directory. Public search and elevated/document access differ; no complete estate bulk export claimed. Audit limitation: official Portal and Judicial Branch pages returned HTTP 403 in this environment, including a normal browser; no live case search/document retrieval was verified. The official statewide rollout and county Clerk routing were checked against Judicial Branch published pages; use normal user access or contact the county Clerk for records. No bypass automation.

sources.agency: New Hanover County Planning / Code Enforcement
sources.notes: County COAST code-compliance concern/record guidance. County jurisdiction is distinct from Wilmington municipal minimum housing/nuisances; select code records rather than construction permits. Request existing case records/export under North Carolina Chapter 132 where records are not public; a complaint form is not a records request. No new inspection or custom analysis.

sources.agency: Brunswick County Tax Administration / Real Property
sources.notes: Official county real-property search by owner, parcel/PIN or situs address. Individual assessment/ownership records, not a countywide bulk file and not proof of delinquency. Use the normal gateway and any required disclaimer/session.

sources.agency: Brunswick County parcel data — NC DIT / CGIA (NC OneMap)
sources.notes: Complete Brunswick County parcel ownership/assessment layer within NC OneMap's statewide service; county-filtered Query gateway, not an individual lookup. Set Out Fields to *, Return Geometry to false for a table, format JSON, and paginate using Result Offset/Record Count (service limit 5000) or retrieve all object IDs and query batches. County counts and sample records were verified; one response is not a complete export. Includes parcel IDs, owner, mailing/situs address, land/improvement/parcel values, acreage, use codes and source dates where supplied. Source dates vary and some are invalid; this is not a certified current CAMA/tax roll. Request missing building detail/exemptions and current existing CAMA file from County Tax Administration. Older OneMap ZIP links returned 404 and were excluded.

sources.agency: Brunswick County Tax Administration / Collections
sources.notes: Individual Tax Status. Official tax-account/bill search; check outstanding prior years and unpaid balance for real-property accounts. This is not a full countywide delinquent dataset or a tax-sale inventory. Ask Tax Collections for the existing current electronic delinquent real-property account list if maintained.

sources.agency: Brunswick County Clerk of Superior Court — Special Proceedings
sources.notes: eCourts Portal Smart Search: choose Brunswick County/location and nonconfidential Special Proceedings for power-of-sale foreclosure cases (SP), then name/case number and filing date. Judicial foreclosures can also be Civil Actions; tax foreclosures are distinct and may be civil or in rem. This is a court case index, not a complete public-notice feed or Florida Lis Pendens. All NC counties have eCourts as of October 13, 2025. Normal session/verification may be required; no bypass. The official statewide rollout and county Clerk routing were checked against Judicial Branch published pages; use normal user access or contact the county Clerk for records. No bypass automation.

sources.agency: Pitt County Tax Administration / Collections
sources.notes: No verified working public bulk delinquency export. County links an ArcGIS Delinquent Taxes item, but its upstream service returned 404/500 during audit; the landing page alone is not a confirmed downloadable dataset. Request the existing current all-year electronic delinquent real-property account list from Tax Collector. County also offers by-email the annual 2025 unpaid-real-estate advertisement (payments through February 28, 2026); older years and later payments are not reflected. Winterville municipal taxes are separately advertised. This request is for existing records, not the separate foreclosure auction list.
